{{Quote|I fought at first, as was my duty&mdash;but I was too old for the front lines.|Jedi Master Ngani Zho|<ref name="LostSuns4" />}}
In or sometime shortly after [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' took place in a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] field on a [[Unidentified planet (Ngani Zho)|planet]]. The revered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] participated in the conflict and fought on the front lines against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Imperial soldier]]s. Although he survived the engagement, Zho afterwards recognized that he was too old to continue fighting on the front lines, and so retired from direct combat and began raising [[Theron Shan]], the son of his former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Satele Shan]], as a pupil.<ref name="LostSuns4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared as a brief flashback in one panel of [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 4|''The Old Republic—The Lost Suns 4'']]. The [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]], released in [[2011]], did not reveal the official name of the conflict or the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on which it occurred.<ref name="LostSuns4" />
